purpose: Fresh pitch holdout within the same recorded piano and microphone setup; not independent-piano validation.

analysis.channel_combination: mean stereo power; no mono waveform summation
analysis.onset: first 1ms RMS envelope crossing a noise-aware threshold near -45dB of the first-second peak
analysis.pitch: joint stiff-string fit to dominant partial peaks; normalized f1 convention
analysis.partial_levels: Hann-window power integrated around each fitted partial, with bandwidth covering window leakage and unison splitting
analysis.decay: Theil-Sen regression of partial-band dB power from 0.25 to 3.5 seconds; not a physical loss identification in isolation
analysis.gain: one scalar from 0.05–0.75s RMS, applied unchanged to all windows
analysis.limits: one piano/recording setup; microphone, room, library editing, unknown physical hammer velocities and acquisition pedal state are confounds; metrics are not perceptual scores
